The job behind e2e-turbopack, split into six groups.
props.text:
jobs:
  e2e-turbopack:
    name: e2e tests (turbopack)
    needs: [build-native, build-next]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        group: [1/6, 2/6, 3/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test-start-turbo --group ${{ matrix.group }}
        env:
          NEXT_TEST_MODE: start
          TURBOPACK_BUILD: 1
